go_no_go: NO-GO: 3/10 EPIC sources exceed 1% mask-rate gate; 3/4 densities exceed absolute 0.5-point-change gate. Mask remains OFF.

masked_tune_report.thinning: score >=0.2; floor(density*duration/60); ties start,end,verb,noun; all=no cap

recomputed_disabled_tune_report.thinning: score >=0.2; floor(density*duration/60); ties start,end,verb,noun; all=no cap

coverage_change_interpretation: All observed tune coverage deltas are positive, not losses. The predeclared #28 gate limits absolute change to <=0.5 percentage points; it fails even though coverage increases. The separate EPIC mask-rate failure independently rules out GO.
frame_quality_limit: Algorithmic mask rates only. No visual footage/card ground truth or FPVSum human review; masked frames are not declared false positives.
other_split_policy: Four other sources used only for label-free mask rates and importance fidelity; their GT coverage was not scored.
